t: Fast acting, low-odour formula helps eliminate bed bugs and dust mites around the home and protects against their return. Features traditional nozzle or extended lance spray option for easy application when treating soft furnishings and for crack and crevice treatments in hard-to-reach areas. Ideal for treating bed frames, skirting boards and other furnishings. Contains Cyphenothrin and Prallethrin.
b: For use Against Bed Bugs & Dust Mites
Not Suitable for Use Around Pets
